records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:14 — destroy calls `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and immediately calls `host.destroy` without a nil check, so a missing/already-deleted id (e.g. double-click or race) raises NoMethodError (500) instead of a graceful error.
records.rationale: The destroy action does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` then `host.destroy` with no nil check; a nonexistent id raises NoMethodError → 500. Also update action has the same nil issue via save_host. Real defect, though minor severity (admin-only).

records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:9 — update calls `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first`, which is nil for an unknown/already-deleted id, then `save_host(nil)` calls `host.host = ...` on nil, causing a 500 instead of a 404/error response.
records.rationale: The diff shows `update` in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` then `save_host(host)`, and `save_host` immediately does `host.host = params[...]` — a nil id yields nil host and a NoMethodError (500), instead of a 404. Same risk in `destroy` (`host.destroy` on nil). No nil guard exists anywhere in the diff.
